notes.title: Dooria V1.3
notes.content:
- Added support for German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Portuguese (Brazilian), Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese languages.
- Fully integrated controller support
- Remapped keyboard controls to fit with different keyboard layouts
- Some minor audio and visual updates

A complete game guide is now available for those who are either stuck or are determined to go deep.

And lastly, there's now a short demo version available for MacOS and Windows.

- Audio tweaks and music updates
